product_brief.brief_description: Design a clean label vegan creamy ranch dressing containing at least 30% fat, at most 3% sugar, and pourable emulsion viscosity. Requires herbal dill-garlic flavour, low syneresis, 6-month ambient shelf life, and raw material cost under 6.5 USD/kg. Exclude eggs, dairy buttermilk, and modified starches.
